z-m-40-07.title: Kana tikakwidza mutsetse wakatwasanuka, mapoinzi okusangana anongowedzera here?
z-m-40-07.topic: Graph ye quadratic ine kukosha kwakakwana y=|x²−4| nokuti huwandu hwemapoinzi okusangana nomutsetse wakatwasanuka hunochinja sei
z-m-40-07.goal: Tsanangura kuti sei huwandu hwemapoinzi okusangana husingangowedzera asi hunochinja sezvo kukwirira k kwomutsetse wakatwasanuka kuchichinja, uchihubatanidza nechimiro chegraph (pamusoro pakapetwa napoinzi rinobata x-axis).
z-m-40-07.material: Huwandu hwemapoinzi apanosangana graph yefunction y = |x² − 4| (inoverengwa: 'kukosha kwakakwana kwe x squared minus 4') nomutsetse wakatwasanuka y = k hwakaenzana nehuwandu hwemidzi chaiyo yakasiyana yechirevo |x² − 4| = k. Pazasi pane kukosha kwe y kwakaverengwa pamakukosha mamwe e x. Kana x i −3, −2, −1, 0, 1, 2, 3, y i 5, 0, 3, 4, 3, 0, 5.
z-m-40-07.thinking.1: Kutsvaga kukosha kwa k kunoita semiganho
z-m-40-07.prereq.0: Mwero wakagoverwa H3 imwero wokuoma chete mukugoverwa uku kwokugadzira, uye haireve kuti kurikuramu inoisa zvirimo izvi muGredhi rakati. Fungidziro: watoziva graph yefunction yequadratic, zvinoreva kukosha kwakakwana, nokududzira kwokuti midzi chaiyo yechirevo ndiyo mapoinzi okusangana kwegraph nomutsetse wakatwasanuka.
z-m-40-07.prereq.1: Mhinduro dzechirevo chequadratic x² = m (mbiri kana m > 0, imwe kana m = 0, hapana kana m < 0)
z-m-40-07.prereq.2: Kukosha kwakakwana |t| i t kana t ≥ 0 uye −t kana t < 0
z-m-40-07.s.s1.prompt: Ruzivo runoratidzwa sezvo k ichichinja. Nguva imwe neimwe, sarudza huwandu hwemapoinzi okusangana.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.hint.0: Tevera kukosha patafura, uye uverenge kangani graph inopfuura nepa y = k, muganho mumwe panguva imwe.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.hint.1: Paradzanisa kuva zvirevo zviviri x² − 4 = k ne x² − 4 = −k, uye utsvage kuti x mbiri dzinobuda kubva kune rimwe nerimwe.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.0.info: Kutanga, dhirowa mutsetse wakatwasanuka y = 1, ne k = 1.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.0.ask: Mutsetse wakatwasanuka y = 1 unoshandira mapoinzi akasiyana mangani negraph?
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.0.after: |x² − 4| = 1 zvinoreva x² − 4 = 1 kana x² − 4 = −1, saka x² = 5 kana x² = 3. x = ±√5, ±√3, mapoinzi 4. Patafura, kukosha kunodzika kubva pa x = 1 (y = 3) kusvika pa x = 2 (y = 0), uye kunokwira kubva pa x = 2 kusvika pa x = 3 (y = 5), saka kurutivi rwokurudyi inopfuura y = 1 kaviri, uye rutivi rwokuruboshwe zvakafanana.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Uku kufunga kwokuti inosangana sepeya imwe chete, kuruboshwe nokurudyi, separabola.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Uku kufunga kwokuti, kutevera chimiro chekukosha patafura kuchidzika wobva wakwira, inopfuura kaviri kurutivi rwokuruboshwe nokurudyi rumwe nerumwe.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Uku kufunga kwokuti, nokuda kwechimiro chinobata x-axis, poinzi rimwe rinowedzerwa.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Uku kufunga kwokuti, sezvo pasina x ine y = 1 patafura, hazvisangani. Funga kukosha pakati pezvinyorwa zvetafura.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.1.info: Panguva ino, dhirowa mutsetse wakatwasanuka y = 4, ne k = 4. Patafura, y = 4 kana x = 0.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.1.ask: Mutsetse wakatwasanuka y = 4 unoshandira mapoinzi akasiyana mangani negraph?
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.1.after: Kubva pa x² − 4 = 4, x = ±2√2 (mapoinzi 2), uye kubva pa x² − 4 = −4, x = 0 (poinzi 1), uye haapindirani, saka pane 3 dzose. k = 4 ihurefu hwepamusoro pechikamu chakapetwa kumusoro pa x = 0, saka mutsara wakarara unongobata pamusoro.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Uku kufunga kuti nhamba yakafanana kunyange kana k ichichinja.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Uku kufunga kunosiya kubata kamwe pa x = 0 ndokuverenga mapoinzi maviri ekunze chete.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Uku kufunga kunoverenga pamwe chete poinzi imwe yekubata pa x = 0 nemapoinzi maviri ekunze.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Uku kufunga kuti nokuti k yakura, mapoinzi ekusangana anowedzerawo.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.2.info: Pakupedzisira, dhirowa mutsara wakarara y = 5, ne k = 5.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.2.ask: Mutsara wakarara y = 5 unogovana mapoinzi akasiyana mangani negraph?
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.2.after: Kubva pa x² − 4 = 5, x = ±3 (mapoinzi 2), uye x² − 4 = −5 zvinoreva x² = −1, iyo isina midzi chaidzo. Pane 2 dzose. Kana k yava huru kupfuura 4, mutsara wakarara unokwira pamusoro pepamusoro pakapetwa, uye matavi maviri ekunze chete ndiwo anosara.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Uku kufunga kuti kana ukakwidza k zvakanyanya, mapoinzi ekusangana anowedzera.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Uku kufunga kunotakura nhamba kubva kana k = 4.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Uku kufunga kuti sezvo yapfuura hurefu hwepamusoro 4, haachasangani. Ongorora kana pane x ine y = 5 mutebhura.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Uku kufunga kuti kana yakwira pamusoro pepamusoro pakapetwa, inosangana nenzvimbo mbiri dzekunze chete.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.reflect: Wakafunga here kuti mapoinzi ekusangana anowedzera chete kana k ichikwidzwa? Tsanangura kuti nei, kana k ichikwidzwa kubva pakukosha kudiki zvikuru, nhamba yemapoinzi ekusangana inochinja se 0 → 2 → 4 → 3 → 2, uchiibatanidza nemapoinzi egraph anobata x-axis nepamusoro pakapetwa.
z-m-40-07.s.s2.prompt: Sezvo k ichikwidzwa zvishoma nezvishoma kubva panhamba diki yakaipa, nyora makosha ose emuganhu e k umo nhamba yemapoinzi ekusangana inochinja, uye utsanangure kuti chikamu chipi chegraph chinopfuurwa nemutsara wakarara pamuganhu wega wega.
z-m-40-07.s.s2.hint.0: Mutebhura, wana kukosha kudiki zvikuru kwe y nehurefu hwechikamu chakapetwa padhuze ne x = 0.
z-m-40-07.s.s2.hint.1: Isa k pasi pemuganhu uye pamusoro pawo, uye uenzanise nhamba dzemapoinzi ekusangana.
z-m-40-07.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakatsanangura here kuti nei makosha emuganhu e k ari iwayo, uye kuti ihurefu hwepoinzi ipi pagraph?
z-m-40-07.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Pamuganhu wega wega (kana k iri diki kupfuura muganhu uye kana iri huru), wakataura here kuti pane mapoinzi ekusangana mangani?
z-m-40-07.s.s2.model.0: Miganhu i k=0 ne k=4. k=0 ihurefu hwe x=±2, apo mutsara wakarara unobata x-axis, uye kana ukapfuura iyoyo, pane mapoinzi ekusangana 4. k=4 ihurefu hwepamusoro pakapetwa pa x=0, saka panguva iyoyo pane 3, uye kana yakura kupfuura 4, 2 chete dzinosara.
z-m-40-07.s.s2.model.1: Kana ukakwidza mutsara wakarara, unotanga kubata graph pa k=0 (mapoinzi ekusangana 2), pakati pe0 ne4 pane 4, pa k=4 unopfuura pamusoro pa x=0 uye pane 3, uye kana k yakura kupfuura 4 unosangana nenzvimbo mbiri dzekunze chete, saka pane 2. Saka makosha anoita kuchinja i0 ne4.
z-m-40-07.s.s2.modelNote.1: Iyi mhinduro inosanganisirawo nyaya yemapoinzi 0 kana k < 0.

z-m-40-04.title: Parwendo rwekuenda nekudzoka, kudzoka kunofanira kumhanya sei kuti avhareji yekumhanya ive yakati?
z-m-40-04.topic: Avhareji yekumhanya kwerwendo rwekuenda nekudzoka inoratidzwa nerational function: inochinja sei nekumhanya kwekudzoka, nemuganhu wayo
z-m-40-04.goal: Ongorora nenguva kuti avhareji yekumhanya kwerwendo rwekuenda nekudzoka haisi arithmetic mean yekumhanya, tarisa muganhu weavhareji kunyange kana kumhanya kwekudzoka kwakawedzerwa kuburikidza nekufanotaura nekuverenga, wobva wawana iwe amene kumhanya kunogutsa mamiriro.
z-m-40-04.material: Bhazi rinoita rwendo rwekuenda nekudzoka panzira imwe chete. Pakuenda rinomhanya nekumhanya kusingachinji kwe30 km paawa, uye pakudzoka rinomhanya nekumhanya kusingachinji kwe x km paawa. Chinhambwe chekuenda chete D km hachizivikanwi, uye hapana kumira panzira. Avhareji yekumhanya inotsanangurwa se (chinhambwe chose chakafambwa) ÷ (nguva yose yakatorwa).
z-m-40-04.thinking.1: Kuverenga chimiro chekuchinja (hukuru pakutanga, wobva wadzikira zvishoma nezvishoma)
z-m-40-04.prereq.0: Nhanho yakagoverwa H3 ingori nhanho yekuoma mukugoverwa kwekugadzira uku, uye hairevi kuti kharikhulamu inoisa zvinyorwa izvi kugiredhi rakati. Fungidziro: wakatoziva kumhanya = chinhambwe ÷ nguva uye kuverenga nemaexpression ezvidimbu.
z-m-40-04.prereq.1: Kuverenga nemaexpression erational (ezvidimbu), nekunzwa kwekuti chidimbu chinodzikira kana denominator ichikura
z-m-40-04.prereq.2: Mutemo wekuti avhareji yekumhanya = chinhambwe chose ÷ nguva yose yakatorwa
z-m-40-04.s.s1.prompt: Ruzivo runobuda chimwe chidimbu panguva. Nguva imwe neimwe, sarudza kuti avhareji yekumhanya kwerwendo rwekuenda nekudzoka ichava yakaita sei.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.hint.0: Gadzirisa chinhambwe chekuenda chete kukosha kwakati sa60 km, uye uwane nguva yakatorwa pakuenda nepakudzoka zvakaparadzana.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.hint.1: Mushure mekuwana chinhambwe chekuenda nekudzoka nenguva yose yakatorwa, edza kana mugumisiro uchichinja kana ukachinja chinhambwe chekuenda chete kuita kukosha kumwe.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.0.info: Tora zuva rakava nekumhanya kwekudzoka kwe60 km paawa semuenzaniso. Chinhambwe chekuenda chete D hachisati chazivikanwa.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Avhareji yekumhanya kwerwendo rwekuenda nekudzoka ichava yakaita sei pazuva iri?
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Kana D = 60 km, kuenda kunotora 60 ÷ 30 = 2 maawa uye kudzoka kunotora 60 ÷ 60 = 1 awa, saka rwendo rwe120 km rwakatora maawa 3. Avhareji yekumhanya i120 ÷ 3 = 40 km/h. Mugumisiro mumwe chete unobuda kune makosha mamwe e D (D inobvisana). Ishoma kupfuura 45 nokuti nguva yakawanda yakapedzwa ichimhanya nekumhanya kunononoka.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Kufunga uku kunotora arithmetic mean yekumhanya (pakati pe30 ne60) seavhareji yekumhanya.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Kufunga uku kunofunga kuti nguva yakawanda yakapedzwa ichimhanya nekumhanya kunononoka.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Uku kufunga kuti chikamu chinomhanya chine simba rakakura. Enzanisa nguva yakatorwa pachikamu chega chega.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Hatizivi D, saka hatigoni kuziva avhareji yekumhanya futi
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Uku kufunga kuti unogona kuverenga chete kana chinhambwe chakati. Edza kuisa D pa60 uye uenzanise nemamwe makosha.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Tarisa zuva rakava nekumhanya kwekudzoka kwakawedzerwa kusvika pa120 km paawa.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Kumhanya kwekudzoka kwapetwa kaviri (60 → 120). Avhareji yekumhanya ichachinja sei kubva pa40 km/h?
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Kana D = 120 km, kuenda kunotora maawa 4 uye kudzoka kunotora awa 1, saka huwandu i240 ÷ 5 = 48 km/h. Kunyange kumhanya kwakapetwa kaviri, avhareji yakawedzera ne20% chete. Izvi zvinokonzerwa nokuti nguva yakatorwa pakuenda inoramba iri imwe chete, saka nguva yose haidzikiri kusvika pahafu.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Inokwira kusvika padyo nokuwedzera kaviri, padyo ne 80 km/h
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Uku kufunga kwokuti kana kumhanya pakudzoka kwakapetwa kaviri, avhareji inopetwawo kaviri zvichienderana.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Avhareji yokumhanya haichinji zvikuru uye inoramba padyo ne 40
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Uku kufunga kwokuti shanduko yokumhanya pakudzoka haikanganisi zvikuru avhareji.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Inokwira kubva pa 40 asi haisvike pakuwedzera kaviri
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Uku kufunga kunofunga kuti nguva yakatorwa pakuenda inoramba yakafanana.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Uku kufunga kwokuti chikamu chinokurumidza chinodzima muavhareji.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Kunyange kumhanya pakudzoka kukakwidzwa kusvika ku 300 km paawa, avhareji yokumhanya inenge 54.5 km/h.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Tichifungidzira kuti kumhanya pakudzoka kunogona kuitwa kukuru sezvaunoda, avhareji yokumhanya kwokuenda nokudzoka inogona kusvika ku 60 km paawa here?
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Avhareji yokumhanya i 60x ÷ (30 + x). Nguva yokuenda yatoshandiswa, saka kunyange nguva yokudzoka ikaitwa padyo ne 0, avhareji inongoswedera ku 2D ÷ (D/30) = 60 uye haisvike. Kana x = 150 i 50, kana 300 inenge 54.5, uye kana 600 inenge 57.1.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Kana ukamhanya nokukurumidza zvakakwana pakudzoka, unogona kusvika pakupedzisira
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Uku kufunga kwokuti kana ukakwidza kumhanya, avhareji inokwirawo pasina muganho.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Kana kumhanya pakudzoka kuri 90 km paawa, kunova 60 chaizvo
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Uku kufunga kwokuti kunokodzera chaizvo pakumhanya kwakati. Verenga iwe pachako avhareji kana kumhanya kuri 90 km paawa.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Panosvika nguva iyo inosvika pa 60; hazvisi chaizvo chete
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Uku kufunga kunotora kukosha komuganho sekunogona kusvikwa. Tsvaga kuti nguva inofanira kutora yakadini kuti avhareji ive 60.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Uku kufunga kunofunga kuti nguva yakatorwa pakuenda yatogadzikwa.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.reflect: Pakutanga unogona kunge wakafunga avhareji yokumhanya seavhareji yokumhanya (45). Ruzivo rupi (nguva yakatorwa) rwakachinja kufunga uku? Tsanangura chimiro umo avhareji inokwira sezvaunokwidza kumhanya pakudzoka (huru pakutanga, wobva wadzikira zvishoma nezvishoma) uye kuti sei muganho we 60 unooneka.
z-m-40-04.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza kumhanya x pakudzoka (km paawa) kuti avhareji yokumhanya kwokuenda nokudzoka ive kubva pa 50 km paawa kusvika pa 55 km paawa, uye utsvage kukosha 3 kwakasiyana kwa x. x inhamba yakazara yakanaka, uye kumhanya pakuenda i 30 km paawa.
z-m-40-04.s.s2.hint.0: Gadzika chinhambwe chomutsetse mumwe pakukosha kumwe, isa kukosha kwokumhanya x pakudzoka, uye uverenge avhareji yokumhanya.
z-m-40-04.s.s2.hint.1: Chinja x kuva 100, 200, 300 nezvimwe, uye uderedze kuenda kupanowira avhareji yokumhanya pakati pe 50 ne 55.
z-m-40-04.s.s2.fail.c1: x inofanira kuva nhamba yakazara iri pamusoro pe 0.
z-m-40-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Avhareji yokumhanya iri pasi pe 50. Verenga zvakare avhareji kubva panguva dzakatorwa pakuenda napakudzoka.
z-m-40-04.s.s2.fail.c3: Avhareji yokumhanya iri pamusoro pe 55. Verenga zvakare avhareji.
z-m-40-04.s.s2.explain: Avhareji yokumhanya i 60x ÷ (30 + x), uye kukosha kwa x umo iri kubva pa 50 kusvika pa 55 kuri kubva pa 150 kusvika pa 330. Sezvo x ichikura, avhareji inowedzera asi inosvika padyo ne 60, saka muganho wa x unobvumirwa wakafara.

z-m-40-05.thinking.2: Kutaura kuti ruzivo rupi rwekuwedzera runodiwa
z-m-40-05.title: Function yeradical ine gumo (−2, 1): ine fomula imwe chete here?
z-m-40-05.topic: Function yeradical y=√(ax+b)+c: rusununguko runosara kana fomula yagadzikwa neruzivo rwegumo
z-m-40-05.goal: Tonga kuti ruzivo pamusoro pegumo rimwe rinogadzika zvinhu zvisingachinji zvingani zvefunction yeradical uye rinosiya zvingani, gadzira iwe pachako mafomula akasiyana anogutsa mamiriro, uye utsanangure kuti chii chimwe chinodikanwa kugadzika curve kuva imwe.
z-m-40-05.material: Pascreen yekirasi, graph yefunction yeradical y = √(ax + b) + c (inoverengwa: 'square root ye a x plus b, plus c') yakaoneka. Curve ine gumo rayo rokuruboshwe pa (−2, 1) uye inoenda kubva ipapo kuenda kumusoro kurudyi. a, b, c zvinhu zvisingachinji, uye sezvo ichienda kurudyi, a > 0. Hazvizikanwi kuti curve inopfuura mapoinzi api mamwe.
z-m-40-05.prereq.0: Mwero wakagoverwa H3 imwero wokuoma chete mukugoverwa uku kwokugadzira, uye haireve kuti kurikuramu inoisa zvirimo izvi muGredhi rakati. Fungidziro: unoziva kuti graph yefunction yeradical y = √(ax + b) + c inotanga pagumo uye inoenda kurutivi rumwe.
z-m-40-05.prereq.1: Nhamba dzine square root inhamba yakazara (masikweya akakwana)
z-m-40-05.prereq.2: Kuverenga kutsvaga kukosha kwe y nokuisa x = k mufomula
z-m-40-05.s.s1.prompt: Zvinogoneka here kuti a, b, c dzose dzigadzikwe kuva dzimwe chete neruzivo rwokuti gumo ri (−2, 1) chete?
z-m-40-05.s.s1.hint.0: Funga kuti kukosha mukati meradical kunofanira kuva kupi kana ukaisa koodhineti ye x yegumo, −2, mufomula √(ax + b) + c.
z-m-40-05.s.s1.hint.1: Gadzira mafomula maviri ane gumo rimwe chete asi a dzakasiyana, uye uenzanise kana magraph akafanana.
z-m-40-05.s.s1.o.a: c yakagadzikwa asi a inosara, uye b inogadzikwa na a
z-m-40-05.s.s1.r.a: Uku kufunga kunoongorora kuti ruzivo pamusoro pegumo runobatana sei nehuwandu hwezvinhu zvisingachinji.
z-m-40-05.s.s1.o.b: Zvakagadzikwa: kubva pamakoodhineti egumo, b = −2, c = 1, uye a = 1
z-m-40-05.s.s1.r.b: Uku kufunga kunotamisa makoodhineti egumo zvakananga kuzvinhu zvisingachinji. Kana ukaisa x = −2 muchirevo, unogona kutarisa zvinoreva gumo.
z-m-40-05.s.s1.o.c: Hazvina kugadzikwa: a, b, c dzinogona kusarudzwa dzega zvakasununguka
z-m-40-05.s.s1.r.c: Uku kufunga kwokuti poinzi rimwe harina kurambidza chinhu pakati pezvinhu zvisingachinji. Nyora mamiriro anopiwa negumo kufomula.
z-m-40-05.s.s1.o.d: Zvakagadzikwa: inopfuura pagumo, saka zvinhu zvose zvitatu zvisingachinji zvakagadzikwa kuva zvimwe chete
z-m-40-05.s.s1.r.d: Uku kufunga kwokuti mamiriro mumwe chete anogadzika zvinhu zvose zvitatu zvisingachinji. Gadzira mafomula maviri ane gumo rimwe chete uye uaenzanise.
z-m-40-05.s.s1.explain: Koodhineti ye y yegumo i c, saka c = 1. z-m-40-11.goal: Tsvaga mutsara wekutanga unokanganisa mumhinduro yakarongedza zviratidzo nehukama hwa a, b, c kubva pazvimiro zvina ze graph, simbisa kuti nei usina kururama nekuedza nenhamba chaidzo, uye ugadzire iwe pachako (a, b, c) inogutsa mamiriro ose mana.
z-m-40-11.material: Tinotsanangura graph ye quadratic function y = ax² + bx + c nemashoko chete. ① Inovhura kuzasi (chimiro ∩). ② Vertex iri kurudyi kwe y-axis (x-coordinate ye vertex i positive). ③ Poinzi inosangana ne y-axis iri pasi pe x-axis (y-coordinate yayo i negative). ④ Inosangana ne x-axis pamapoinzi maviri akasiyana. a, b, c ndiconstants dze real. Pazasi pane mhinduro yaHyunwoo, umo akasarudza zviratidzo za a, b, c kubva patsanangudzo iyi.

Fungidziro: wakatodzidza kuti mu y = ax² + bx + c, c ndiyo y-intercept, x-coordinate ye vertex i −b/(2a), uye discriminant ine hukama nenhamba yemapoinzi ekusangana ne x-axis.

z-m-40-11.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsara wekutanga mumhinduro yaHyunwoo unokanganisa.
z-m-40-11.s.s1.hint.0: Paradzanisa kutonga kwechiratidzo kwemutsara mumwe nemumwe, uye utarise kana kwakarurama nekuisa nhamba chaidzo (semuenzaniso a = −1).
z-m-40-11.s.s1.hint.1: Pamutsara 3, edza nenhamba kuti chiratidzo che numerator chinofanira kuva chipi kuti quotient ive positive kana denominator i negative.
z-m-40-11.s.s1.line.1: ③ Y-coordinate yepoinzi inosangana ne y-axis ndiyo kukosha c pa x = 0, saka c < 0.
z-m-40-11.s.s1.line.2: ② X-coordinate ye vertex, −b/(2a), i positive uye a < 0, saka numerator −b inofanirawo kuva positive. Naizvozvo b < 0.
z-m-40-11.s.s1.line.3: ④ Inosangana pamapoinzi maviri akasiyana, saka b² − 4ac > 0.
z-m-40-11.s.s1.explain: Inokanganisa pamutsara 3. Kana −b/(2a) i positive uye denominator 2a i negative, saka kuti quotient ive positive numerator −b inofanira kuva negative. Saka b > 0. Mutsara 5 unotora kukanganisa uku. Mitsara 1, 2, 4 yakarurama.
z-m-40-11.s.s2.prompt: Ndeupi mutsvairo wakakurumidza kuratidza kuti zviratidzo zvakasarudzwa naHyunwoo (a < 0, b < 0, c < 0) zvinokodzera tsananguro here?
z-m-40-11.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza nhamba chaidzo dzinokodzera zviratidzo zvaHyunwoo uye uzadzise fomula y = ax² + bx + c.
z-m-40-11.s.s2.hint.1: Nefomula iyoyo, tarisa matsanangudzo ① kusvika ④ rimwe rimwe.
z-m-40-11.s.s2.o.a: Verenga nzvimbo ye vertex ne a = −1, b = −4, c = −3
z-m-40-11.s.s2.r.a: Uku ndiko kufunga kunoshandura mhedzisiro yekutonga kuita makosha chaiwo ndokuigoverenga nemamiriro etsananguro.
z-m-40-11.s.s2.o.b: Verenga zvakare uone kana b² − 4ac > 0 inoshanda
z-m-40-11.s.s2.r.b: Uku kufunga kunotarisa zvakare mutsara wakanyorwa zvakarurama. Mutsara 4 hauna kukanganisa mumhinduro iyi.
z-m-40-11.s.s2.o.c: Sezvo c < 0, tarisa zvakare kana graph ichisangana ne y-axis pasi pe x-axis
z-m-40-11.s.s2.r.c: Uku kufunga kunotarisa zvakare mutsara wakanyorwa zvakarurama. Mutsara 2 hauna kukanganisa mumhinduro iyi.
z-m-40-11.s.s2.o.d: Fungidzira kuti kana a < 0 saka y < 0 kune x yose, uye udhirowe graph
z-m-40-11.s.s2.r.d: Uku kufunga kuti kana ichivhura kuzasi, makosha ose ari negative. Vertex inogonawo kuva pamusoro pe x-axis.
z-m-40-11.s.s2.explain: Kana (a, b, c) = (−1, −4, −3), saka y = −x² − 4x − 3 uye x-coordinate ye vertex i −b/(2a) = −2, iri negative. Haienderani netsananguro ② (vertex iri kurudyi kwe y-axis), saka b < 0 hazvina kururama.
z-m-40-11.s.s3.prompt: Tsvaga ma triples e integer 3 akasiyana (a, b, c) anogutsa matsanangudzo ose ① kusvika ④. (a ≠ 0 uye −6 ≤ a, b, c ≤ 6)
z-m-40-11.s.s3.hint.0: Rongedza zvakaparadzana kuti ndezvipi zvezviratidzo zvakanyorwa kana hukama hwa a, b, c zvinotaurwa ne ① kusvika ④ rimwe rimwe.
z-m-40-11.s.s3.hint.1: Sarudza mumwe mutendi, uise ① kusvika ④ rimwe rimwe, utarise kuti unobatirwa pamamiriro api, wobva wagadzirisa.

z-m-40-11.s.s3.fail.c4: ③: Poinzi inosangana ne y-axis haisi pasi pe x-axis.

z-m-40-11.s.s3.fail.c5: ④: Haisangani ne x-axis pamapoinzi maviri akasiyana.
z-m-40-11.s.s3.explain: ①→a < 0, ③→c < 0, ②→zviratidzo za a ne b zvakapesana (saka b > 0), ④→b² > 4ac. Semuenzaniso, y = −x² + 4x − 3 inosangana ne x-axis pa x = 1, 3 uye vertex yayo i (2, 1).

z-m-40-13.thinking.0: Kutaura kuti ruzivo rupi rwekuwedzera runodiwa
z-m-40-13.title: Tinogona here kutaura mhinduro ye inequality kubva pamapoinzi maviri ekusangana chete?
z-m-40-13.topic: Hukama hwenzvimbo hwe quadratic function ne line: mhinduro ye inequality f(x) > g(x) kana x-coordinates chete dzemapoinzi maviri ekusangana dzichizikanwa
z-m-40-13.goal: Nzwisisa kuti x-coordinates dzemapoinzi maviri ekusangana oga hadzitari kuti graph ipi iri pamusoro, saka mhinduro ye inequality inokamurwa kuita zvinogoneka zviviri, simbisa kuti ruzivo rwepoinzi imwe runochinja sei kutonga, uye ugadzire iwe pachako quadratic function ne line yenyaya yakapesana.
z-m-40-13.material: Graph (parabola) ye quadratic function y = f(x) ne line y = g(x) zvinosangana pamapoinzi maviri, x = 1 ne x = 5. Ndiko kuti, f(1) = g(1) ne f(5) = g(5). Tinoda kuziva mhinduro ye inequality f(x) > g(x). Sua akati, “Mhinduro iri pakati pemapoinzi maviri ekusangana.” Haisati yazikanwa kana parabola ichivhura kuzasi kana kumusoro.
z-m-40-13.thinking.1: Kuongorora kana ruzivo rutsva ruchisimbisa hwaro hwekutonga
z-m-40-13.prereq.0: Level yakapiwa H3 inongova nhanho yekuoma mukugoverwa kwekugadzira uku, uye haireve kuti curriculum inoisa zvirimo izvi mugiredhi chairo. Fungidziro: wakatoziva pfungwa yemapoinzi ekusangana e quadratic function ne line, uye kuti chiratidzo che quadratic expression chakasiyana pakati pemaroots maviri nekunze kwawo.
z-m-40-13.prereq.1: Kuenzanisa makosha e function, nepfungwa yekutarisa function f(x) − g(x) se function itsva
z-m-40-13.prereq.2: Nzira iyo quadratic function inovhura nayo (kuzasi, kumusoro)
z-m-40-13.s.s1.prompt: Kana x-coordinates chete dzemapoinzi ekusangana, 1 ne 5, dzichizikanwa, chii chinogona kutaurwa nezve mhinduro ye inequality f(x) > g(x)?
z-m-40-13.s.s1.hint.0: Dhirowa iwe pachako kana pane mapikicha anoita akasiyana asi aine mapoinzi maviri ekusangana akafanana.
z-m-40-13.s.s1.hint.1: Dhirowa graph ye f kana ichivhura kuzasi uye kana ichivhura kumusoro, uye wenzanise kuti ndeipi iri pamusoro pakati pemapoinzi maviri ekusangana.
z-m-40-13.s.s1.o.a: Mhinduro inotarwa kuti iri pakati pemapoinzi maviri ekusangana, 1 < x < 5
z-m-40-13.s.s1.r.a: Uku kufunga kuti pakati pemapoinzi ekusangana nguva dzose ndipo pari mhinduro. Dhirowa zvinoitika kana parabola ikakotama kune rimwe divi.
z-m-40-13.s.s1.o.b: Mhinduro inotarwa kuti iri kunze kwemapoinzi ekusangana, x < 1 kana x > 5
z-m-40-13.s.s1.r.b: Uku kufunga kuti kunze kwemapoinzi ekusangana nguva dzose ndiko kuri mhinduro. Dhirowa zvinoitika kana parabola ikakotama kune rimwe divi.
z-m-40-13.s.s1.o.c: Zviitiko zvose zviviri zvinogoneka, saka ruzivo rwekuwedzera runodiwa pamusoro pekuti ndeipi iri pamusoro
z-m-40-13.s.s1.r.c: Uku kufunga kuti nzvimbo dzemapoinzi ekusangana oga hadzitari kuti ndeipi iri pamusoro.
z-m-40-13.s.s1.o.d: Hatigoni kuziva: nekuti tinodawo y-coordinates dzemapoinzi maviri ekusangana
z-m-40-13.s.s1.r.d: Uku kufunga kuti y-coordinates dzinodiwa kunyange x-coordinates dziri ruzivo rwakakwana. Tsvaga zvinodiwa kuti utare kuti ndeipi iri pamusoro.
z-m-40-13.s.s1.explain: f(x) − g(x) i quadratic expression uye i0 pa x = 1, 5, saka ine chimiro p(x − 1)(x − 5) (p ≠ 0). Kana p < 0, mhinduro ndi 1 < x < 5, uye kana p > 0, ndi x < 1 kana x > 5. Chiratidzo che p hachigoni kuzikanwa kubva pamapoinzi ekusangana oga.
z-m-40-13.s.s2.prompt: Ruzivo rutsva rwauya: pa x = 3, f(3) = 7 ne g(3) = 3. Tingatarisa sei zvino chirevo chaSua “1 < x < 5”?
z-m-40-13.s.s2.hint.0: Tarisa f(x) − g(x) se function itsva, uye tanga wanyora kana kukosha kwayo pa x = 3 kuri positive kana negative.
z-m-40-13.s.s2.hint.1: Funga kana chiratidzo che quadratic expression chingachinja pakati pemaroots maviri, uye chinofanira kupfuura papi kuti chichinje.
z-m-40-13.s.s2.o.a: Chiratidzo chinochinja pa 1 ne 5 chete, uye pa x = 3 f iri pamusoro, saka pakati ndipo pari mhinduro
z-m-40-13.s.s2.r.a: Uku kufunga kunoziva kuti nei chiratidzo papoinzi imwe chinotamira kune interval yose.
z-m-40-13.s.s2.o.b: Tichiri kusagona kuziva. Poinzi imwe haigoni kuva hwaro hwe interval yose
z-m-40-13.s.s2.r.b: Uku kufunga kunoshaya kuona kuti ruzivo papoinzi imwe runotamira kune interval yose. Tsvaga kana chiratidzo chingachinja pakati pemapoinzi maviri ekusangana.
z-m-40-13.s.s2.o.c: x < 1 kana x > 5 ndiyo mhinduro. Kure nemapoinzi ekusangana, f inowedzera kuva pamusoro
z-m-40-13.s.s2.r.c: Uku kufunga kunosarudza nzira pasina hwaro. Verenga zvakare kukosha pa x = 3.
z-m-40-13.s.s2.o.d: Inoshanda pa x = 3 chete, uye hatigoni kuziva pamamwe x
z-m-40-13.s.s2.r.d: Uku kufunga kunoshaya kuona kuti kukosha kunochinja zvinoenderera, saka kunofanira kupfuura nepa 0 kuti chiratidzo chichinje.
z-m-40-13.s.s2.explain: f(x) − g(x) i quadratic expression, saka nzvimbo dzega dzinochinja chiratidzo ndidzo maroots x = 1, 5. Pa x = 3 pakati pemaroots maviri, kana f − g = 4 > 0, saka i positive pakati pose uye negative kunze. Saka mhedziso yaSua zvino ine hwaro. Pakutanga, yaiva mamiriro apo mhedziso ingadai yakarurama kana kusarurama.
z-m-40-13.s.s3.prompt: Panguva ino, gadzira nyaya apo mhedziso yaSua isina kururama. Rega f(x) = px² + qx + r (p ≠ 0) ne g(x) = mx + n, uye utsvage (p, q, r, m, n) 2 dzakasiyana dzakadaro kuti graph mbiri dzisangane pa x = 1 ne x = 5 uye f(3) < g(3).
z-m-40-13.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora mamiriro emapoinzi maviri ekusangana se equations f(1) = g(1) ne f(5) = g(5).
z-m-40-13.s.s3.hint.1: Sarudza imwe yema p, q, r kutanga, wobva wagadzirisa m ne n kuti g ipfuure napamapoinzi maviri (1, f(1)) ne (5, f(5)).
z-m-40-13.s.s3.fail.c2: Pa x = 1, f(1) ne g(1) dzakasiyana.
z-m-40-13.s.s3.fail.c3: Pa x = 5, f(5) ne g(5) dzakasiyana.
z-m-40-13.s.s3.fail.c4: Pa x = 3, f(3) haisi diki kupfuura g(3).
z-m-40-13.s.s3.explain: Sezvo f(x) − g(x) = p(x − 1)(x − 5), f(3) − g(3) = −4p. Saka kana p > 0, f(3) < g(3), uye f > g kunhi x < 1 kana x > 5. Kana p < 0, pakati ndipo pari mhinduro. Kunyange nenzvimbo dzakafanana dzemapoinzi ekusangana, mhinduro inosiyana zvichienderana nenzira parabola inovhura nayo.

z-m-40-01.title: Ngatisarudzei domain kuti inverse function ivepo
z-m-40-01.topic: One-to-one correspondence ne inverse functions: kudzikisa domain kuita chikamu kuti f(x)=x²−2x ive ne inverse function
z-m-40-01.goal: Nzwisisa kuti tafura inotarisa mitengo mishoma haisi humbowo hwe “one-to-one,” gadzira iwe pachako chikamu chedomain ye quadratic function kuti mutengo mumwechete usaitika kaviri, uye wobva wasimbisa kuti domain ye inverse function i range ye function yekutanga.
z-m-40-01.material: Funga function f(x) = x² − 2x (verenga se: 'x squared minus 2x'). Domain haisati yasarudzwa. Kutaura kuti f ine inverse function paseti imwe kunoreva kuti hapana ma x maviri akasiyana museti iyoyo anopa mutengo mumwechete we f (ipapo range ye f inova domain ye inverse function). Seojin akagadzira tafura apo f(x) yaiva −1, 0, 3, 8 kuna x = 1, 2, 3, 4, dzose dzakasiyana, uye akati, “f ine inverse function pa real numbers dzese.”
z-m-40-01.thinking.0: Kufunga kuti humbowo hwemuenzaniso hunosvika papi
z-m-40-01.thinking.1: Kugadzira ma domains akati wandei anogutsa mamiriro
z-m-40-01.thinking.2: Kutonga kuti kuva one-to-one kunochinja sei zvichienderana nemamiriro e domain
z-m-40-01.prereq.0: Level yakapiwa H3 i kuoma bedzi mukugoverwa uku kwekugadzira, uye hazvireve kuti curriculum inoisa zvirimo izvi pagiredhi rakatarwa. Fungidziro: wakatodzidza one-to-one correspondence nezvinoreva inverse functions (hukama hunochinjanisa domain ne range).
z-m-40-01.prereq.1: Ruzivo rwekuverenga mitengo ye function ye quadratic nekudhonza chimiro chiri padyo che parabola
z-m-40-01.s.s1.prompt: Tafura yaSeojin ingave humbowo hwechirevo “f ine inverse function pa real numbers dzese” here? Sarudza zvinogona kutaurwa kubva patafura.
z-m-40-01.s.s1.hint.0: Sarudza x isiri patafura, verenga mutengo we f, uye uenzanise kana ichipindirana nemitengo iri patafura.
z-m-40-01.s.s1.hint.1: Isa mitengo mishoma isiri patafura, sa x = 0, −1, 5, uye utarise kana mutengo wakatoonekwa uchidzoka.
z-m-40-01.s.s1.o.a: Mitengo mina iri patafura yese yakasiyana, saka kunyangwe domain i real numbers dzese, tinogona kutaura kuti mutengo mumwechete hauoneki kaviri
z-m-40-01.s.s1.r.a: Kufunga uku kunowedzera mhedzisiro shoma dzakatariswa kuma x ese asati atariswa. Edza ma x ari kunze kwetafura zvakare.
z-m-40-01.s.s1.o.b: Sezvo x yakawedzera, f(x) yakawedzerawo, saka f i increasing function, uye saka i one-to-one
z-m-40-01.s.s1.r.b: Kufunga uku kunowedzera tsika yekukwira yakaonekwa patafura kuchikamu chese. Tarisa kana tsika imwechete ichishanda parutivi apo x i diki kupfuura 1.
z-m-40-01.s.s1.o.c: Tebhura inongovhara x = 1 kusvika 4, saka kana kukosha kumwe chete kuchioneka pa x iri kunze kwetebhura kunofanira kuongororwa zvakaparadzana
z-m-40-01.s.s1.r.c: Kufunga uku kunoongorora kuti humbowo hunosvika kupi nezve x.
z-m-40-01.s.s1.o.d: Kana tikaongorora ma integer gumi akawanda uye ose akasiyana, tinogona kupedza tichiti ndeye one-to-one panhamba chaidzo dzose
z-m-40-01.s.s1.r.d: Kufunga uku kunoti kuwedzera nhamba yemapoinzi akaongororwa kunogadzirisa zvose. Kuongorora nhamba yakaverengeka yemapoinzi, kunyange ichikura sei, hakugoni kubvisa muenzaniso unopokana.
z-m-40-01.s.s1.explain: Tebhura inoratidza chete kuti kukosha kumwe chete hakuoneki pa x = 1, 2, 3, 4. Hatigoni kuziva nezve x iri kunze kwetebhura, uye chaizvoizvo pane x dzine kukosha kumwe chete, sa f(0) = 0 = f(2). Kuongorora nhamba yakaverengeka yemapoinzi hakugadzirisi kuti zvose ndeze one-to-one.
z-m-40-01.s.s2.prompt: Vaka ma domain 3 [a, b] anosanganisira x = 0 uye umo inverse function iripo. Mamiriro: a ne b ma integer, −6 ≤ a < b ≤ 6, uye hurefu hweinterval b − a i2 kana kupfuura.
z-m-40-01.s.s2.hint.0: Dhirowa graph ye f(x) = x² − 2x nokupfupika uye utarise kuti mapoinzi maviri ari paukuru hwakafanana ari kupi.
z-m-40-01.s.s2.hint.1: Wana x imwe ine kukosha kwakafanana ne x = 0, uye ufunge mamiriro ekuti poinzi iyoyo isava mukati meinterval.
z-m-40-01.s.s2.fail.c1: a inofanira kuva integer diki kupfuura b.
z-m-40-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Zvose −6 ≤ a, b ≤ 6 ne b − a ≥ 2 zvinofanira kushanda.
z-m-40-01.s.s2.ok.c4: Mukati meinterval iyi hapana mapoinzi maviri akasiyana ane kukosha kwe f kwakafanana.
z-m-40-01.s.s2.fail.c4: Mukati meinterval iyi pane mapoinzi maviri akasiyana ane kukosha kwe f kwakafanana. Tsvaga peya yemapoinzi ari paukuru hwakafanana mukati meinterval.
z-m-40-01.s.s2.explain: Sezvo f(x) = (x − 1)² − 1, graph yakaenzana kuruboshwe nekurudyi kupoteredza axis x = 1. Kana interval ichipararira mativi ose e x = 1, mapoinzi maviri ari padhuze rakafanana neaxis ane kukosha kwakafanana (semuenzaniso, mu [0, 2], f(0) = f(2) = 0). Kuti usanganisire x = 0 uye udzivise izvi, tinoda b ≤ 1, uye ipapo f inoramba ichidzikira paninterval.
z-m-40-01.s.s3.prompt: Seojin akasarudza domain [−2, 0]. Paninterval iyi, ndeipi domain ye inverse function f⁻¹ ye f (= range ye f)?
z-m-40-01.s.s3.hint.0: Verenga f(−2), f(−1), f(0) uye utarise kuti makosha anochinja sei paninterval.
z-m-40-01.s.s3.hint.1: Ongorora nepoinzi imwe yekuwedzera kana makosha ekumagumo maviri einterval anova magumo maviri e range.
z-m-40-01.s.s3.r.a: Kufunga uku kunotora domain ye inverse function ne domain yefunction yepakutanga seset imwe chete. Mu inverse function, nzvimbo dze input ne output dzinochinjana.
z-m-40-01.s.s3.r.b: Kufunga uku kunoongorora makosha efunction f(0) = 0 ne f(−2) = 8 pamagumo maviri einterval uye kunobatanidza zviri pakati pazvo.
z-m-40-01.s.s3.r.c: Kufunga uku kunoshandisa kukosha −1 pa vertex seminimum zvisinei neinterval. Ongorora kana vertex iri mukati meinterval iyi.
z-m-40-01.s.s3.r.d: Kufunga uku kunosiya mugumo wepamusoro wakavhurika usina kuuongorora. Verenga kukosha pamugumo wekuruboshwe weinterval, x = −2.
z-m-40-01.s.s3.explain: f(−2) = 8, f(−1) = 3, f(0) = 0, saka paninterval iyi f inodzikira uye inotora makosha ose kubva pa0 kusvika pa8. Saka domain ye f⁻¹ i 0 ≤ x ≤ 8.

z-m-40-03.title: Kana mafomula achioneka akafanana, ma graph akafananawo here?
z-m-40-03.topic: Kunyora zvakare rational functions nema domain azvo: kuenzanisa ma graph e (x²−1)/(x−1) ne x+1
z-m-40-03.goal: Nzwisisa kuti kuti maexpression maviri anoita akafanana mushure mekupfupisa anzi function imwe chete, ma domain awo anofanirawo kuva akafanana, uye utaure nenyaya kuti zvakanaka rinhi kuadhirowa segraph imwe chete uye kuti hazvina rinhi.
z-m-40-03.material: Pane functions mbiri f(x) = (x² − 1)/(x − 1) ne g(x) = x + 1. (Verenga se: 'x squared minus 1, divided by x minus 1'.) Kana domain isina kunyorwa zvakaparadzana, tinoitora seyenhamba chaidzo dzose dzinogona kuverengwa neexpression. Jia akati, “Numerator x² − 1 = (x − 1)(x + 1), uye kana ukabvisa, inova x + 1, saka f ne g function imwe chete uye ma graph azvo akafanana.”
z-m-40-03.thinking.0: Kusarudza chinhu chekutanga chekuongorora kuedza chirevo
z-m-40-03.thinking.2: Kutaura kuti mhinduro inochinja zvichienderana nemamiriro
z-m-40-03.prereq.0: Nhanho yakagoverwa H3 ingori nhanho yekuoma mukugoverwa kwekugadzira uku, uye hairevi kuti kharikhulamu inoisa zvinyorwa izvi kugiredhi rakati. Fungidziro: wakatoziva kuparadzanisa, kubvisa maexpression ezvidimbu, nemutemo wekuti domain yefunction inhamba chaidzo dzose dzinogona kuverengwa neexpression.
z-m-40-03.prereq.1: Chokwadi chekuti kana denominator i0, kukosha kweexpression hakuna kutarwa
z-m-40-03.prereq.2: Graph yelinear function y = x + 1 (mutsara wakananga)
z-m-40-03.s.s1.prompt: Tinoda kuedza chirevo chaJia. Sarudza chinofanira kuongororwa kutanga.
z-m-40-03.s.s1.hint.0: Isa x = 1 mufomula ye f. Chii chinoitika?
z-m-40-03.s.s1.hint.1: Isawo x = 1 mufomula ye g, uye uenzanise migumisiro miviri.
z-m-40-03.s.s1.o.a: Tarisa kana miganhu ye x umo maexpression maviri anogona kuverengwa yakafanana
z-m-40-03.s.s1.r.a: Uku kufunga kunorangarira kuti kutaura kuti functions dzakafanana kunosanganisirawo domain.
z-m-40-03.s.s1.o.b: Tarisa kana makosha emaexpression maviri akafanana pa x = 2, 3, 4
z-m-40-03.s.s1.r.b: Uku kufunga kunoedza kusarudza kuti functions dzakafanana kubva pamapoinzi mashoma umo makosha akaenzana. Dzinogona kusiyana pamakosha e x asina kuedzwa.
z-m-40-03.s.s1.o.c: Tarisa kana graph iri mutsara wakananga, sezvo maexpression ose maviri ari linear
z-m-40-03.s.s1.r.c: Uku kufunga kunofungidzira kuti f yatova expression yakananga yakapfupiswa. Fomula ye f iri muchimiro chechidimbu.
z-m-40-03.s.s1.o.d: Nyora zvakare g(x) muchimiro chechidimbu kuti uipe chimiro chakafanana ne f
z-m-40-03.s.s1.r.d: Uku kufunga kunotora functions seakafanana kana zvimiro zvemafomula zvichienderana. Kuchinja chimiro kunogona kuchinja muganhu we x umo inogona kuverengwa.
z-m-40-03.s.s1.explain: Kuti functions mbiri dzive dzakafanana, zvose domain nekuenderana zvinofanira kuva zvakafanana. Saka kuongorora kwakananga zvikuru ndekutanga kuenzanisa muganhu we x umo expression yega yega inogona kuverengwa.
z-m-40-03.s.s1.acc.0: Kuverenga makosha mashoma kutangira kwakanaka. Asi, chokwadi chekuti akaenzana pa x = 2, 3, 4 hachigoni kubata musiyano pakukosha kusina kuedzwa sa x = 1.
z-m-40-03.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza zvikonzero zvose zvinogona kushandiswa kuratidza kuti f ne g hazvisi function imwe chete.
z-m-40-03.s.s2.hint.0: Tarisa sarudzo imwe neimwe, uchisiyanisa kana ichiratidza “musiyano” kana ichiratidza rutivi rwe “kufanana” chete.
z-m-40-03.s.s2.hint.1: Enzanisa zvinoitika kana ukaisa x = 1 mu f ne g nesarudzo.
z-m-40-03.s.s2.o.a: Pa x = 1, g(1) = 2, asi f(1) haina kutarwa nokuti denominator i0
z-m-40-03.s.s2.r.a: Uku kufunga kuti chokwadi chekuti divi rimwe chete rine kukosha papoinzi imwe chinoratidza musiyano pakati pefunctions mbiri.
z-m-40-03.s.s2.o.b: Pa x = 2, f(2) = 3 ne g(2) = 3, saka functions mbiri dzine kukosha kwakafanana
z-m-40-03.s.s2.r.b: Chokwadi chekuti makosha akaenzana papoinzi imwe hachisi humbowo hwekuti functions dzakafanana kana humbowo hwekuti dzakasiyana.
z-m-40-03.s.s2.o.c: Domain ye f inhamba chaidzo dzine x ≠ 1, uye domain ye g inhamba chaidzo dzose
z-m-40-03.s.s2.r.c: Uku kufunga kunoshandisa chiyero chekuti functions dzine ma domain akasiyana hadzisi function imwe chete.
z-m-40-03.s.s2.o.d: Kune x yose ine x ≠ 1, f(x) = x + 1 inoshanda, saka makosha emaexpression maviri akaenzana
z-m-40-03.s.s2.r.d: Kuenzana kune x ≠ 1 ihumbowo hwerutivi rwe “kufanana” chete, uye hahutauri chinhu nezvemusiyano pa x = 1.
z-m-40-03.s.s2.explain: Pa x = 1, f haina kukosha uye g i2, uyewo ma domain akasiyana, saka functions mbiri hadzina kufanana. Zvokwadi zvekuti makosha akaenzana pa x = 2 kana kuti maexpression akaenzana kune x ≠ 1 ihumbowo hwerutivi rwe “kufanana”, saka hazvigoni kuratidza musiyano.
z-m-40-03.s.s3.prompt: Nyora mhinduro kuna Jia. Tsanangura nekupatsanura nyaya umo f ne g zvinogona kudhirowewa segraph imwe chete nenyaya umo zvisingagone, uchisanganisira chakasiyana pagraph.
z-m-40-03.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga wanyora mumutsara mumwe kuti chii chinoitika mumaexpression maviri kana ukaisa x = 1.
z-m-40-03.s.s3.hint.1: Funga kuti zvinhu zvaizochinja sei mumamiriro umo x isingambovi 1.
z-m-40-03.s.s3.placeholder: Muenzaniso: Jia, maexpression maviri ... kana ..., asi ...
z-m-40-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora zvakajeka here nemashoko ako mamiriro emamiriro umo zvakanaka kutaura kuti akafanana?
z-m-40-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Munyaya ye “hazvina kunaka”, wakacherekedza here zvakananga kuti poinzi ipi pagraph yakasiyana?
z-m-40-03.s.s3.model.0: Chero bedzi x isiri 1, maexpression maviri anopa kukosha kumwe chete, saka kana tichibata nzvimbo dzine x ≠ 1 chete, tinogona kuzvidhirowa segraph imwe chete. Asi f haina kutarwa pa x = 1, saka graph ye f imutsara y = x + 1 une poinzi imwe chete (1, 2) isipo.
z-m-40-03.s.s3.model.1: Hatigoni kutaura kuti ifunction imwe chete. Kana x i1, f haina kukosha nokuti denominator i0, asi g i2. Saka ma graph anopindirana kunze kwe1, asi f ine gomba. Kana dambudziko rinobata muganhu x > 1 chete, migumisiro yakafanana kunyange kana tichizvichinjana.

z-m-40-06.title: Chii chinodikanwa kuti hukama hwakabatanidzwa kubva pazvidimbu huve one-to-one?
z-m-40-06.topic: Mamiriro eparameter ekuti function ye piecewise ive one-to-one, nomusiyano ne one-to-one correspondence
z-m-40-06.goal: Nzwisisa kuti function ye piecewise i one-to-one chete kana miganho yekukosha kunoitwa nezvidimbu zviviri isingapindirani, uye usiyanise one-to-one ne one-to-one correspondence (range ndiyo codomain yose) uchishandisa muganho wa a.
z-m-40-06.material: Pane function f(x) = x + 2 (x < 1), f(x) = ax − 1 (x ≥ 1). (a chinhu chisingachinji. Verenga: kana x iri pasi pe 1, 'x plus 2'; kana x i 1 kana kupfuura, 'a x minus 1'.) “One-to-one” zvinoreva kuti hapana x mbiri dzakasiyana dzinopa kukosha kwefunction kumwe chete, uye “one-to-one correspondence” ndiko uko uye zvakare range inoenzana ne codomain (nhamba chaiyo dzose). Domain ne codomain zvose ndenhamba chaiyo dzose.
z-m-40-06.thinking.0: Kufunga muganho unoreverwa nemhedzisiro yokuverenga kukosha kumwe
z-m-40-06.thinking.1: Kutsvaga maparameter akati wandei anogutsa mamiriro
z-m-40-06.thinking.2: Kusiyanisa mamiriro e one-to-one ne one-to-one correspondence
z-m-40-06.prereq.0: Mwero wakagoverwa H3 imwero wokuoma chete mukugoverwa uku kwokugadzira, uye haireve kuti kurikuramu inoisa zvirimo izvi muGredhi rakati. Fungidziro: watodzidza zvinoreva function, matsananguro e one-to-one function ne one-to-one correspondence, nokuverenga kukosha kwemafunction e piecewise.
z-m-40-06.prereq.1: Kukwira nokudzikira kwegraph yefunction yomutsetse (chiratidzo che slope)
z-m-40-06.s.s1.prompt: Minseo akaisa a = 2 uye akaverenga: f(−1) = 1, f(0) = 2, f(1) = 1, f(2) = 3. Chii chingataurwa nechokwadi kubva pakuverenga uku?
z-m-40-06.s.s1.hint.0: Isa kukosha kusiri a = 2 (semuenzaniso 5), verenga f(−1) ne f(1), uye uzvienzanise.
z-m-40-06.s.s1.hint.1: Funga kana chokwadi chokuti haisi one-to-one kuna a imwe chichikanganisa mhedzisiro kuna a dzimwe.
z-m-40-06.s.s1.o.a: Kana a = 2 haisi one-to-one, uye pamusoro pe a dzimwe hatigoni kuziva kubva pakuverenga uku oga
z-m-40-06.s.s1.r.a: Uku kufunga kunoshandisa mhedzisiro yechinhu chimwe chisingachinji kuchinhu ichocho chete.
z-m-40-06.s.s1.o.b: f(−1) = f(1) yakabuda, saka chero a yatinoisa, f haisi one-to-one
z-m-40-06.s.s1.r.b: Uku kufunga kunotsanangudza mhedzisiro yechinhu chimwe chisingachinji kuzvinhu zvose zvisingachinji. Edza zvinoitika kuna f(−1) ne f(1) kuna a dzimwe.
z-m-40-06.s.s1.o.c: f(2) = 3 ndiyo kukosha kukuru, saka kana a = 2, f i one-to-one
z-m-40-06.s.s1.r.c: Uku kufunga kunotonga kana i one-to-one kubva pachokwadi chokuti kukosha kukuru kumwe kwabuda. Tarisa kana pane nzvimbo umo kukosha kwakafanana kwakabuda kaviri.
z-m-40-06.s.s1.o.d: Kubva pakuverenga uku oga hatigoni kuziva kana i one-to-one kuna a ipi zvayo
z-m-40-06.s.s1.r.d: Uku kufunga kunosiya kunyange zvinotaurwa nechokwadi nokuverenga pamusoro pe a = 2. Enzanisazve kukosha kwe f(−1) ne f(1).
z-m-40-06.s.s1.explain: Kana a = 2, f(−1) = f(1) = 1, saka zvakajeka kuti haisi one-to-one. A dzimwe dzinofanira kutarisirwa zvakasiyana.
z-m-40-06.s.s2.prompt: Tsvaga kukosha 3 kwakasiyana kwa a umo f i one-to-one. (−10 ≤ a ≤ 10; madhesimari anobvumirwa.)
z-m-40-06.s.s2.hint.0: Isa kukosha kumwe kwa a, uye unyore muganho wekukosha kunoitwa nechidimbu chokuruboshwe nomuganho wekukosha kunoitwa nechidimbu chokurudyi.
z-m-40-06.s.s2.hint.1: Tarisa kana miganho miviri ichipindirana, uye utsvage kuti kuti isapindirana, kukosha kudiki kwechidimbu chokurudyi kunofanira kuva kwakadini kana kupfuura.
z-m-40-06.s.s2.ok.c1: a i kubva pa −10 kusvika pa 10.
z-m-40-06.s.s2.fail.c1: a inofanira kuva kubva pa −10 kusvika pa 10.
z-m-40-06.s.s2.ok.c2: Kukosha kwechidimbu chokuruboshwe nokwechidimbu chokurudyi hakupindirane.
z-m-40-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Kuna a iyi, pane x1, x2 dzakasiyana dzine f(x1) = f(x2). Tsvaga x umo fomula yokuruboshwe (x < 1) neyokurudyi (x ≥ 1) dzinopa kukosha kwakafanana.
z-m-40-06.s.s2.explain: Chidimbu chokuruboshwe (x < 1) chinopa kukosha kwose kuri pasi pe 3. Kuti chidimbu chokurudyi (x ≥ 1) chive mutsetse unokwira, a > 0, uye miganho yezvose haipindirane chete kana chidiki f(1) = a − 1 i 3 kana kupfuura. Ndiko kuti, a ≥ 4. Kana a < 4, kukosha kwakafanana kunobuda kaviri.
z-m-40-06.s.s3.prompt: Panguva ino tinoda kutsvaga a umo f i one-to-one correspondence (range inhamba chaiyo dzose). Chii chakarurama?
z-m-40-06.s.s3.hint.0: Isa mumvuri pamutsetse wenhamba kukosha kunogona kuitwa na f kana a = 5, uye utarise kana pane kukosha kwashaikwa.
z-m-40-06.s.s3.hint.1: Enzanisa mamiriro a = 4 ne a = 5, uye utarise kana kukosha kuchibatana padyo ne x = 1.
z-m-40-06.s.s3.r.a: Uku kufunga kwokuti kana i one-to-one saka i one-to-one correspondence. Kana range inhamba chaiyo dzose inofanira kuongororwa zvakasiyana.
z-m-40-06.s.s3.r.b: Uku kufunga kwakavhiringidzwa nokubata kukosha 3 pa x = 1 pakukosha komuganho a = 4. Enzanisa kukosha kunoitwa na f kana a = 4 nekana a = 5.
z-m-40-06.s.s3.r.c: Uku kufunga kwokuti zvakakwana kuti chidimbu chokurudyi chingokwira. Tarisa kana chichipindirana nekukosha kwechidimbu chokuruboshwe.
z-m-40-06.s.s3.r.d: Uku kufunga kunofungawo nemamiriro okuti kuti range ive nhamba chaiyo dzose, hapana kukosha kunofanira kushaikwa.
z-m-40-06.s.s3.explain: One-to-one correspondence inoda kuti range ive nhamba chaiyo dzose, saka hapana kukosha kunogona kushaikwa. Chidimbu chokuruboshwe chinopa kukosha kwose pasi pe 3, uye chidimbu chokurudyi chinopa kukosha kwose kwe a − 1 kana kupfuura. Kuti hapana kupindirana uye hapana mukaha pakati pazvo, a − 1 = 3, ndiko kuti, a = 4. Kana a > 4, kukosha pakati pe 3 ne a − 1 hakuna chinhu, saka i one-to-one asi haisi one-to-one correspondence.

z-m-40-09.title: Nemisha miviri uye nemisha mitatu, chiteshi chebhazi chinofanira kuiswa kupi?
z-m-40-09.topic: Huwandu hwema absolute value functions: graph yemutsara wakakotama wehuwandu hwemachinhambwe S(x) nekuti ishoma zvikuru kupi
z-m-40-09.goal: Nzwisisa kuti huwandu hwemachinhambwe kumisha miviri une pasi rakadzvanyirirwa, saka nzvimbo yeminimum inzvimbo dzakawanda, simbisa kuti nemisha mitatu nzvimbo yeminimum yakagadziriswa kuita nzvimbo imwe chete, uye ufanotaure iwe amene nyaya yemisha mina.
z-m-40-09.material: Panzira yakananga, nzvimbo dzinoratidzwa se x km. Musha A uri pa x = 2 uye musha B uri pa x = 6. Tinoda kuvaka chiteshi chimwe chebhazi panzvimbo x panzira. Kana huwandu hwemachinhambwe kubva pachiteshi kuenda kumusha wega wega i S(x), ipapo S(x) = |x − 2| + |x − 6|. (Verenga se: 'the absolute value of x minus 2, plus the absolute value of x minus 6'.) Chiteshi chinogona kuvakwa kwose panzira.

z-m-40-09.thinking.2: Kufanotaura mutemo kana nhamba yemisha ichichinja

z-m-40-10.title: Kana makosha ari mutebhura akaenzana kuruboshwe nekurudyi, graph inewo symmetric here?
z-m-40-10.topic: Symmetry yegraph yefunction pa y-axis: simba rehumbowo rekuti mapeya mashoma emakosha akaenzana, nekuvaka mienzaniso inopokana
z-m-40-10.goal: Uchitevedza tsanangudzo yesymmetry pa y-axis (f(−x) = f(x) kune x yose), nzwisisa kuti tebhura inoratidza mapeya mashoma emakosha akaenzana haigoni kusarudza symmetry, uye uvake iwe amene muenzaniso unopokana kubva pafunction inoenderana netebhura chaizvo asi isiri symmetric.
z-m-40-10.material: Fomula yefunction f haizivikanwi, uye pane tebhura ine makosha pa x mashoma chete. Kana x iri −2, −1, 0, 1, 2, f(x) i4, 1, 0, 1, 4. Makosha pa x asiri mutebhura haazivikanwi. Domain inhamba chaidzo dzose, uye “symmetric pa y-axis” zvinoreva kuti f(−x) = f(x) inoshanda kunhamba chaidzo x dzose. Jiho akati, “Mutebhura makosha pa x ne −x akaenzana, saka graph ye f i symmetric pa y-axis.”
z-m-40-10.thinking.0: Kufunga kuti humbowo hwakaverengeka hunosvika kupi
z-m-40-10.prereq.0: Nhanho yakagoverwa H3 ingori nhanho yekuoma mukugoverwa kwekugadzira uku, uye hairevi kuti kharikhulamu inoisa zvinyorwa izvi kugiredhi rakati. Fungidziro: wakatoziva revo yesymmetry pa y-axis (kana poinzi (x, y) iripo, ipapo (−x, y) iripowo) nekuverenga makosha emapolynomial.

z-m-40-10.prereq.2: Kunzwa kwekuti kutsiva x ne −x kunochinja chiratidzo chemazwi edhigirii odd
z-m-40-10.s.s1.hint.0: Paradzanisa x dziri mutebhura neasiri, uye utarise kana f(−x) ne f(x) dzichigona kuenzaniswa kune imwe neimwe.

z-m-40-10.s.s1.r.a: Uku kufunga kunosiyanisa mapeya akaongororwa nemakosha asina kuongororwa.
z-m-40-10.s.s1.o.b: Mapeya ose maviri akaongororwa mutebhura akarurama, saka zvasimbiswa kuti graph i symmetric pa y-axis
z-m-40-10.s.s1.r.b: Uku kufunga kunotambanudza mapeya mashoma akaongororwa kune x dzose. “Kune x dzose” kunosanganisira x dzisiri mutebhura.
z-m-40-10.s.s1.o.c: Pane mapeya maviri chete, saka hapana chingataurwa netebhura iyi
z-m-40-10.s.s1.r.c: Uku kufunga kunokanda kunyange chokwadi chekuti kunoshanda kumapeya maviri akaongororwa. Verenga zvakare zvinoratidzwa chaizvo netebhura.
z-m-40-10.s.s1.o.d: Mapeya ose maviri akarurama, saka zvinoita sekuti ari symmetric uye zvakatoratidzwa chaizvo
z-m-40-10.s.s1.r.d: Uku kufunga kunotora nhamba inowedzera yemapeya akaongororwa sekufanana nehumbowo. Kuongorora kwakaverengeka hakugoni kubvisa muenzaniso unopokana.
z-m-40-10.s.s1.explain: Tebhura inoratidza kuti f(−x) = f(x) pa x = ±1, ±2 chete. Pa x dzisiri mutebhura hazvizivikanwi, saka hatigoni kusimbisa kuti ari symmetric pa y-axis.
z-m-40-10.s.s2.prompt: Zvikonzero zvakaita sei zvinodiwa kusimbisa kuti graph i symmetric pa y-axis?
z-m-40-10.s.s2.hint.0: Enzanisa kana x imwe chete yakakwana kuita muenzaniso unopokana unoratidza kuti haisi symmetric, uye kuti x dzingani dzakakwana kusimbisa kuti i symmetric.
z-m-40-10.s.s2.hint.1: Enzanisa nhamba yezvikonzero zvinodiwa pakuratidza “kune zvose” nepakurambidza.
z-m-40-10.s.s2.o.a: Kana tikanyorawo makosha pa x = ±3, ±4, ±5 mutebhura uye ose akafanana, symmetry inosimbiswa
z-m-40-10.s.s2.r.a: Uku kufunga kuti kana ukawedzera mapoinzi akawanda, zvose zvinosimbiswa. Kunyange kana ukaongorora nhamba yakaverengeka yakawanda, muenzaniso unopokana unogona kusara kunze kwetebhura.
z-m-40-10.s.s2.o.b: Kana ukaisa mapoinzi akawanda ndokuabatanidza, inotora chimiro chinoita seyakaenzana kuruboshwe nekurudyi
z-m-40-10.s.s2.r.b: Uku kufunga kunoshandisa kunzwa kunooneka nemaziso sezvikonzero. Makosha akasiyana zvishoma haaoneki mumufananidzo.
z-m-40-10.s.s2.o.c: Kana fomula yapihwa, verenga f(−x) uye uratidze kuti iexpression imwe chete ne f(x)
z-m-40-10.s.s2.r.c: Uku kufunga kunoratidza kuti kunoshanda kutsamba x, kuchibata “x dzose” pakarepo.
z-m-40-10.s.s2.o.d: Kana chikamu chemapeya akaenderana mutebhura chiri hafu kana kupfuura, symmetry inosimbiswa
z-m-40-10.s.s2.r.d: Uku kufunga kunotonga “kune x dzose” nechiyero chechikamu. Kana kunyange imwe chete ikakundikana, haisi symmetric.
z-m-40-10.s.s2.explain: Kusimbisa “f(−x) = f(x) kune x yose,” unofanira kuratidza nefomula mutsamba x kana kubata x dzose nenzira imwe. Kuongorora mapoinzi akawanda mutebhura kunogona kuwedzera kuvimba, asi hakusimbisi.
z-m-40-10.s.s3.prompt: Functions g(x) = x² + c·x(x² − 1)(x² − 4) (c i constant) dzinogutsa makosha etebhura chaizvo pa x = 0, ±1, ±2 (0; 1, 1; 4, 4) (ongorora iwe amene nekuisa makosha). Vaka humbowo hwekuti dzimwe dzefunctions idzi hadzisi symmetric: sarudza integer c isiri 0 (−3 ≤ c ≤ 3) uye nhamba yakanaka t kuti g(t) ≠ g(−t), uye uwane (c, t) 2 dzakasiyana.
z-m-40-10.s.s3.hint.0: Sarudza c imwe ne t imwe, verenga g(t) ne g(−t) zvakaparadzana, uye wenzanise.
z-m-40-10.s.s3.hint.1: Enzanisa zvinoitika kana ukaisa t se kukosha kuri mutafura (1, 2) uye se kukosha kusiri mutafura (senge 3).
z-m-40-10.s.s3.ok.c1: c i integer isiri zero kubva ku−3 kusvika ku3.
z-m-40-10.s.s3.fail.c1: c inofanira kuva integer isiri zero kubva ku−3 kusvika ku3.
z-m-40-10.s.s3.fail.c2: t inofanira kuva nhamba i positive.
z-m-40-10.s.s3.ok.c3: g(t) ne g(−t) dzakasiyana. Uyu uchapupu hwekuti haisi symmetric pa y-axis.
z-m-40-10.s.s3.fail.c3: Kune t iyi, g(t) ne g(−t) dzakafanana. Ikukosha kuri mutafura kana kukosha apo dzinobuda dzakaenzana. Edza imwe t.
z-m-40-10.s.s3.explain: x(x² − 1)(x² − 4) i0 pa x = 0, ±1, ±2, saka makosha etafura anoramba akadaro, asi kana x ikatsiviwa ne −x, chiratidzo chinopesana. Saka kana t isiri 1 kana 2, g(t) ne g(−t) dzinosiyana nekaviri c·t(t² − 1)(t² − 4). Uyu muenzaniso unopikisa unoratidza kuti makosha mashanu etafura oga haagoni kusimbisa symmetry.
